description: This Java class 'QuestionData' represents a data model for questions within the domain, including properties like id, response data, component key, key, text, description, and sequence number. It includes constructors, getters, and setters.

classes.name: QuestionData
classes.description: A data model class encapsulating question-related data including identifiers, textual content, response options, and ordering info.

methods.name: getResponseDatas
methods.description: Returns the list of response data associated with the question.

methods.name: setResponseDatas
methods.description: Sets the list of response data.

methods.name: getComponentKey
methods.description: Returns the component key associated with the question.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text/content of the question.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the question.
